_comment: Synthetic handshake vectors for protocol v3.5. Shaped exactly like a real capture (the DP payloads are the genuine ones recorded against an A60TY10W on 2026-09-10) but rebuilt around a fabricated local_key, device_id and remote_nonce so no real device credential is committed. local_nonce is the fixed value tinytuya emits in debug mode, which keeps both sides of the handshake reproducible and diffable. Every field below was generated by an independent Python implementation using the `cryptography` package, NOT by this Go package -- so the tests that consume this file still check Go against a second implementation rather than against itself.
